title: Stoke Space raises another billion to rival SpaceX at re-flying rockets | TechCrunch
summary: But unlike its rivals Rocket Lab, Relativity Space or Firefly Aerospace, Lapsa’s company is aiming straight at that holy grail: A rocket where both the booster stage and the payload-carrying second stage come back to Earth so they can be reused cheaply.
